## Round 3 · 2026-11-08 · fix round for verdict 01 (round 2, commit c822e2f)
Addressed the [blocking] deadline finding: on window expiry the body raced the deadline and then still called server.close() while neither the first error nor the client close event had happened.
REPRO: node .scratch/pin-destroy-during-search/tmp/repro-before.test.js (copy of round-2 test, WINDOW_LIMIT_MS 150, search send delayed 800 ms) printed "REPRO bodyClosed=true firstError=false clientClose=false".
Fix: withinWindow() now returns false when the deadline wins, so the body only calls closeServer() when both events arrived. A failed run is cleaned up by t.teardown (client.destroy then closeServer) after the body recorded the failure; a passing run closes the server in the body, after both events.
After the change: repro of the same scenario prints the failure and no body close; 20/20 tap runs pass; self-check PASS (guard, lint, tests; 1 file changed).
VAL-CROSS-001: the round-2 verdict used a per-commit diff (c822e2f^..c822e2f) and saw "M". The decision in decisions.tsv says compare against the mission base: `git diff --name-status 545640d HEAD -- . :!.scratch` prints `A\ttest/destroy-during-search.test.js`. No action was possible or needed.
Ruled out: leaving the repro files nowhere to delete them — the guard blocks `rm` under .scratch/, so repro-before.test.js and repro-after.test.js stay in .scratch/pin-destroy-during-search/tmp/ (outside the diff).
FACTORY_TEXT_END
